name: Furusaka Aya
source: Mysterious girl that was found under the big cherry blossom tree. Not remembering who she is or where she came from, came to be into care of [url=/c3295]Yuuya[/url]'s household, of whom she became a little sister. Has the powers of "Shinsou" (soul performance) and "Shinwan" (divine arm).
translation: Mysterious girl that was found under the big cherry blossom tree. Not remembering who she is or where she came from, came to be into care of [url=/c3295]Yuuya[/url]'s household, of whom she became a little sister. Has the powers of "Shinsou" (soul performance) and "Shinwan" (divine arm).
